lookup.dt: SELECT id FROM locations WHERE name = 'SMOKE {{run}} Downtown' AND kind = 'site' AND timezone = 'America/New_York'
lookup.ap: SELECT id FROM locations WHERE name = 'SMOKE {{run}} Airport' AND kind = 'site' AND siting IS NULL

lookup.app: SELECT id FROM applications WHERE name = 'SMOKE {{run}} Scoped Reservations' AND scope_kind = 'location'

lookup.sdt: SELECT id FROM application_scopes WHERE application_id = {{app}} AND location_id = {{dt}} AND removed_at IS NULL
lookup.sap: SELECT id FROM application_scopes WHERE application_id = {{app}} AND location_id = {{ap}} AND removed_at IS NULL

lookup.priya: SELECT 'yes' FROM app_member_application_scopes({{app}}, 26) WHERE scope_id = {{sap}} AND role_key = 'user' AND capability = 'write' HAVING count(*) = 1
lookup.sam: SELECT 'yes' FROM app_member_application_scopes({{app}}, 6) WHERE scope_id = {{sap}} AND role_key = 'manager' HAVING count(*) = 1
lookup.owner: SELECT 'yes' FROM app_member_application_scopes({{app}}, 1) WHERE role_key = 'admin' HAVING count(*) = 2
lookup.dana: SELECT 'yes' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app_member_application_scopes({{app}}, 5))

lookup.papp: SELECT id FROM applications WHERE name = 'SMOKE {{run}} Dept Projects' AND scope_kind = 'department'

lookup.sit: SELECT id FROM application_scopes WHERE application_id = {{papp}} AND department_id = 6 AND removed_at IS NULL

lookup.it_members: SELECT 'yes' FROM department_members dm CROSS JOIN LATERAL app_member_application_scopes({{papp}}, dm.member_id) x WHERE dm.department_id = 6 AND dm.left_at IS NULL AND x.scope_id = {{sit}} HAVING count(*) >= 1
